title: deguelia polyantha
intro: Deguelia polyantha, commonly known as the West African dogbane, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in African medicine for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Deguelia polyantha include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
